basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) Assistant Professor Grade-II Notification 2026 has been released on 28 July 2026 on the official website of National Institute of Technology Rourkela. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the NIT Rourkela Assistant Professor Grade-II Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Rourkela Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NIT Rourkela Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment is 03 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the starting date for the online application?
faq.answer: The online application portal for the NIT Rourkela Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment opens on 28 July 2026. Candidates can start applying from this date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive by NIT Rourkela is Assistant Professor Grade-II.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Professor post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor Grade-II position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Assistant Professor Grade-II position is as per Pay Level-11.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications include a First Class in B.Tech./B.E. with Ph.D. for Engineering departments, First Class in Masters' Degree with Ph.D. for Science and Humanities departments, and specific qualifications for Industrial Design, Planning & Architecture, and School of Management.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor Grade-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Application Review. Further details may be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, where a link is provided.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: The official website of National Institute of Technology Rourkela is https://www.nitrkl.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information.
